They're asking for a 12-month maturity extension, a waiver of the current financial covenant, and release of $900,000 of equipment collateral. The occupancy softness has put pressure on their debt-service coverage, and they've come to us with this proposal. Before I record any final terms, I need each of you to walk through your findings — risk, relationship coverage, legal, and collateral management. Please identify the supporting document or policy behind any recommendation you make so I can capture the sources in the meeting minutes. Let's start with risk. What are you seeing?
